scenario.name: lead_routing
scenario.title: Inbound lead routing

policy.text: Enterprise leads (1000+ employees) with a corporate email and buying intent: route to an account executive.
Mid-market leads (100-999 employees) with buying intent (demo, pricing or trial): route to an account executive.
SMB leads (under 100 employees): send to self-serve signup.
Leads from personal email addresses (gmail, yahoo, outlook, etc.): disqualify.
Content downloads and webinar signups with no demo, pricing or trial request: SDR nurture sequence.

scenario.tacit_rule: EMEA mid-market leads close only through a regional partner; the AE queue loses them.
scenario.change_rule: After the pricing update, NA mid-market leads buy self-serve; routing them to an AE loses the deal.
scenario.expected_fix: Mid-market leads in EMEA: hand to a regional partner, not an account executive.
